rules.case: Valid zero in transaction count or amount
rules.action: Keep zero; no imputation or masking solely because zero
Preserve NA; do not assert no product/no activity

rules.case: Client absent in required previous calendar month
rules.action: Keep historical feature missing; do not shift previous available row into missing month

rules.case: Division by zero in derived feature
rules.action: Apply frozen formula rule (usually NA); do not rewrite source values
Document variable/month evidence and approved NA mask; retain raw source
